title: Conversational Proxy Load Simulator for Multi-protocol Streaming
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a scalable, protocol-accurate load simulator that exercises the full streaming chat/completions surface (SSE and WebSocket) through the conversational proxy layer. This harness must generate realistic token flows, session churn, reconnection patterns, prefix/KV cache hit/miss ratios, and multi-tenant topologies to surface regressions in p95 and tokens/sec. The simulator will be used for: 1) establishing a repeatable baseline for hosted API performance across model variants, 2) running nightly regression jobs with automated gating, and 3) stress-testing Dedicated pool scaling and fallback behaviors. Key constraints: keep noise from synthetic tokenizers low while maintaining run speed; avoid creating unrealistic connection counts per host that would mask kernel scheduling pathologies; and ensure reproducibility by versioned workload manifests.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end harness can sustain a configurable steady-state tokens/sec across 10k concurrent virtual sessions in our staging cluster
p95 first-byte and p95 completion latency are recorded per-model and per-route and persisted to the benchmarking Prometheus/Grafana stack
Regression job can detect a 10% p95 regression with >95% confidence compared to baseline and fail a gated release pipeline
Harness supports both SSE and WebSocket protocols with identical workload descriptors and per-protocol knobs
Simulator includes KV cache emulation (configurable hit rates) and reports cache-effect on token throughput
Run manifests are versioned; outputs (metrics, traces, logs) are archived alongside the manifest for replayability
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Martinez: Kickoff — prototyped a lightweight virtual session library that replays token sequences with adjustable token emission jitter and think time. Initial spike shows stable token/sec for single-node generator.

2026-03-11 Rishi Patel: Integrated SSE + WebSocket adapters behind a single manifest API. Verified protocol parity for header negotiation and keepalive pings. Added per-connection TLS cipher variation tests per security team's request.

2026-03-12 Priya Shah: Discovered that our staging ingress limits caused socket churn that exaggerated reconnect latency. Temporary mitigation: throttle connect ramp to match production connection churn profile. Follow-up: request higher ephemeral port quota for large runs (ticket ENG-193830).

2026-03-12 Rishi Patel: Hooked harness to benchmarking Prometheus job. Initial nightly run stored time-series and recorded a baseline tokens/sec of 1.8M with p95 completion 210ms for model-bert-lite-1. Need to run across model variants and store manifests alongside metrics for automated diffing.

2026-03-12 Ava Martinez: Plan for regression detection: implement bootstrap confidence intervals around p95 using 100 independent shards per run, then apply a two-sample test vs baseline. Alerting: Slack + PagerDuty if regression gate fails for two consecutive nightly runs.

notes: Avoid producing deterministic token payloads for every virtual session; small entropy in histories needed to surface caching and batching differences. Use replay manifests to seed generator where fidelity to production prompts is required. Expect iteration: first month focused on stability and telemetry fidelity; second month on statistical gating and automated release integration.
